title: Tranq Safari
description: Ride shotgun in an open jeep with a tranquilizer dart rifle. Two routes: a morning run up the valley (raptors, gliders, a stampede, and Rumblejaw chasing you down the river) and a drive through the delta from sunset into night (nipper packs, an armoured Clubtail blocking the road, and the Sailback in a moonlit lagoon). Nobody gets hurt; everybody naps.
controls: Mouse aims, click fires, R or right click reloads. Arrows/WASD aim, Space fires, Esc pause. Touch: drag anywhere to aim, FIRE and RELOAD under your right thumb. Gamepad: stick aims, RT fires, X reloads.
